paper_basic_info.title: 干法纺丝制备 α-Al2O3 陶瓷纤维及其力学性能研究
paper_basic_info.translated_title: Study on Preparation and Mechanical Properties of alpha-Al2O3 Ceramic Fiber by Dry Spinning
paper_basic_info.material_system: alpha-Al2O3 continuous ceramic fiber from pseudo-boehmite-derived alumina sol
paper_basic_info.process_route: aluminium isopropoxide + hydrogen peroxide hydrothermal pseudo-boehmite preparation -> alumina sol + PVA -> dry spinning -> staged calcination/sintering
paper_basic_info.abstract_summary: Pseudo-boehmite prepared by hydrothermal reaction of aluminium isopropoxide and hydrogen peroxide was used to synthesize spinnable alumina sol. Alumina gel fibers were prepared by dry spinning and converted to alpha-Al2O3 continuous ceramic fibers by sintering. Slow heating to 650 C followed by rapid sintering at 1300 C for 10 min gave uniform fibers about 10 um in diameter with maximum breaking strength of 1.37 GPa.

shared_process_summary.precursor_route_summary: Aluminium isopropoxide, distilled water and H2O2 were mixed to form a white suspension, reacted in a PTFE-lined autoclave at 90 C for 6 h with 65-75% filling, centrifuged, washed, dried at 90 C to obtain pseudo-boehmite powder, dispersed in water at 3000 rpm for 2 h, acidified with concentrated nitric acid, stirred 4 h to obtain alumina sol, then mixed with PVA and concentrated at 45 C for 18-24 h to obtain spinnable sol.
shared_process_summary.heat_treatment_route_summary: Gel fibers were heated at 1-5 C/min to 650 C, held for 60 min, then rapidly transferred to a 1100-1350 C furnace for 5-10 min or 10 min depending on the experiment, followed by natural cooling.
shared_process_summary.testing_summary: XRD, FTIR, TG-DSC, SEM and single-fiber tensile strength testing.

mechanism_notes.claim: Low crystallinity pseudo-boehmite with many hydroxyl groups and lattice defects yields small gamma-Al2O3 grains, enabling alpha-Al2O3 transformation at lower temperature and shorter time.
Slow heating below 650 C allows water and polymer decomposition products to be removed gradually, reducing pores and cracks; rapid high-temperature sintering limits grain growth.
